title: 현재 기준 C2MS(축척 혼합 학습)를 다른 센서(GF2·WV3, WV2 전이)에 적용
hypothesis: the C2MS baseline (original + W2, trained with original + 2x coarser pairs; 53) improves over the original SSA-MRN on other sensors as on QB

arms.C0: original SSA-MRN K4 trained on original pairs only (43 procedure; comparison reference)
arms.C2MS: current baseline: original + W2 parallel branch, original + 2x coarser pairs (53 procedure)

transfer_tests.WV2: WV3-trained models evaluated on the WV2 test set (PanCollection convention; WV2 has no training data)

precision: FP16 AMP core training; FP32 transforms/loss/validation/evaluation
loss: per-pixel MSE on the original batch; C2MS adds coarse_weight x per-pixel MSE on the same patches at the 2x coarser scale (normalized by the sensor maximum)
selection: minimum original-scale validation MSE including epoch0, earliest exact tie (43/53 rule); coarse validation is logged only
sensor_operators: prepare.py SENSORS: MS GNyq from DLPan-Toolbox genMTF (GF2 not listed -> toolbox default 0.3, audited exact on GF2 train/valid/test), PAN GNyq from MTF_PAN (GF2 not listed -> toolbox none value 0.15, not auditable); phase 2

judgement.criteria: docs/judgement_criteria.md v2.3 with sensor-specific Wald operators (prepare.py); fixed before training
judgement.primary: per sensor: C2MS vs C0 (original SSA-MRN) of the same seeds, v2.3 label on seed means (3 seeds: noise threshold 0.04 dB; seed 42 interim: 0.06 dB)
judgement.transfer: WV2: WV3-trained C2MS vs WV3-trained C0, same criteria, reported as cross-sensor generalization
judgement.qualitative: result images with common/result_images.py on scenes 0, 1, 3, 7, 14, 17 of each sensor (original vs C2MS, seed 42)
judgement.reported_only: FR QNR, D_lambda, D_s; coarse-scale validation
judgement.note: noise thresholds and guard tolerances were derived from QB seed variation and are applied unchanged to the other sensors

limits: GF2 PAN GNyq 0.15 is the toolbox none value and cannot be checked from the data
PSNR uses peak 2047 for every sensor (common/metrics); GF2 PSNR is offset by about +6 dB, differences are unaffected
QB results are taken from 53; GF2/WV3 C0 are trained here with the 43 procedure
